summary: Higgsfield is an AI platform that offers tools for creating and customizing characters, images, videos, and audio content. Users can upload photos to train characters for consistent use across various media. The site features multiple AI-related services, including marketing tools, supercomputing, and a creative academy. Higgsfield is currently offering a discount on premium plans for new sign-ups. The platform encourages community interaction and offers various resources, such as a help center, terms of use, and a privacy policy.
